stance_rationale: Optimizer handoff is blocked by a hard turnover breach: audited walk-forward annual round-trip turnover is 10.3743, far above the 6.0 hard cap. The package also has method-shopping cap violations, unresolved ES95/CVaR breach, covariance condition-number failure inherited from Risk, and inconsistent handoff artifacts.

method_shopping_audit.selection_method: MVO_lam2_psi0.3_C_secap40; ranked 3rd by net_IR, while package rationale also says regime B was selected

cost_audit.cost_proportionality_check: 15bps formula is arithmetically consistent, but the underlying turnover breaches the 600% annual hard cap.

hard_constraint_violations: stage weights.csv max_w=0.105882352941177 exceeds selected method bound 0.10 on 3 dates

sequential_admission_audit.integration_weight_breakdown: 0-30% new-source grid reported, but 0.0023 is a monthly correlation proxy, not TDC vs PG2/MEGA_05.

critical_concerns.description: Turnover is a hard fail: audited one-way monthly turnover is 0.432263 and annual round-trip turnover is 10.3743, exceeding the 6.0 hard cap. The package acknowledges this but still recommends Forge handoff instead of producing a compliant schedule.

Method shopping violates the <=10 candidate cap with 18 candidates. The stated objective is net_ir, but the selected C_secap40 method ranks 3rd by net_IR, and the JSON rationale contradicts itself by saying regime B was selected.

Risk-side ES95 breach is not resolved: candidate top20 EW ES95 is -10.35% versus a -2.5% cap, but the optimizer uses MVO plus sector cap and defers realized ES measurement to Forge rather than applying CVaR/ES control.

The inherited covariance is PSD but fails the post-shrink condition gate: exact eigen condition number is 753.7499 > 100. A covariance-sensitive MVO selection with only bounds/L1 penalty is not enough evidence that RF-R2/RF-O4 instability is controlled.

Walk-forward artifacts are inconsistent: mailbox weights.csv is absent; actual weights.csv has Date/Ticker/weight/method rather than as_of_date/ticker/weight/method_selected; method is generic 'mvo'; final schedule has 15 names and max_w 0.105882 while weights_forward has 20 names and selected C_secap40 weights. alpha_scores.parquet is also a single 2026-04-30 snapshot, with the panel in a separate file.

Alpha RF-A1 weakness is not truly addressed. Alpha subperiod stability is 0.4242 and DSR fails, while the confidence vector is flat at 0.6626, so the claimed confidence-aware MVO does not materially differentiate weak versus strong alpha evidence.

RF-R3 semiconductor concentration is only partially mitigated from 70% to 40%, still above the Risk recommendation of 30%, and no optimizer_challenge_note.md exists despite sector-cap relaxation, ES breach, and turnover hard fail.
Sequential Admission evidence is incomplete: the package reports a monthly correlation proxy, not TDC vs PG2/MEGA_05, and does not provide a replacement scenario or beta_port versus benchmark target.

supporting_arguments: weights_forward.csv itself passes basic long-only constraints: 20 names, max_w=0.10, sum_w=1.0, min_w=0.0099608324.
weights.csv is not a pure single-snapshot file: it has 196 dates from 2010-01-29 to 2026-04-30.
covariance.parquet is symmetric and PSD with min_eig=0.0001407174; the failure is condition number, not positive definiteness.
The 15bps cost calculation is internally consistent: 0.43226336 monthly one-way turnover times 2 times 15bps times 12 equals about 1.556% annual cost.

Candidate-specific Hill alpha is not reported, so the heavy-tail tie-breaker cannot be verified for the actual optimized portfolio.
No realized candidate backtest, MDD, beta_port, or replacement scenario is present.
weakest_assumption: The weakest assumption is that Forge can safely inherit this optimizer package even though the current monthly schedule already hard-fails turnover and leaves ES95, condition-number, and artifact-lineage problems unresolved.

Resolve covariance cond >100 with a robust optimizer proof or a stricter shrinkage/fallback path.
